name: agent-taskgraph
description: Build native Codex Agent Teams with goals, roles, task graphs, collaboration protocols, and lifecycles.

interface.longDescription: Agent TaskGraph chooses Solo, Delegation, or Team mode, forms a logical team with roles and task dependencies, coordinates native Agents, isolates writes, supervises handoffs and review, and verifies the integrated result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Agent TaskGraph to form and run the smallest effective native Agent Team.
